== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster reduces power from 5 to 3 and forfeit from 7 to 4. The contemporary issuer full image and slip both retain the broad just-drawn destiny adjustment and A Real Hero pull, with the same deploy, ability and Pilot/Warrior icons. Legacy Block 2 prints the later narrower adjustment without A Real Hero.
